{{Quote|We're not going to touch a single one of your microcircuits. We just don't want you to be noticed in a crowd of Kessel droids.|Luke Skywalker to C-3PO inside the Droid Repair Shop|<ref name="Glove" />}}
A '''Droid Repair Shop''' was located on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]]. The shop had shelves containing used [[Droid/Legends|droid]] parts such as heads. It was used by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]<ref name="Glove" /> in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]<ref name="Readers">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[The Glove of Darth Vader]]'', in which the Droid Repair Shop appears, in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].</ref> to prepare the droids [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] for a covert [[Mission to Kessel (Trioculus affair)|mission]] to the planet [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] attempted to reassure C-3PO's apprehension towards the mission while examining droid parts in the shop.<ref name="Glove" />

[[Gender/Legends|He]] selected an evil-looking droid head for C-3PO to use as a disguise, but the droid disliked its [[Color/Legends|green]] color. Skywalker overuled the droid's objections and used an [[inter-office communications device]] to summon the [[Droid Modification Team]], a group of [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droids]], to complete C-3PO's disguise. The droids returned with R2-D2, whom they had already modified to resemble a [[Kesselian spice-mining droid|Kessel mining droid]], and took C-3PO away. The modifications took an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] to implement and, afterward, Skywalker and the droids left the Droid Repair Shop to attend a mission briefing.<ref name="Glove" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Droid Repair Shop appeared in ''[[The Glove of Darth Vader]]'', a [[1992]] junior novel written by [[Paul Davids|Paul]] and [[Hollace Davids]] and illustrated by [[Karl Kesel]].<ref name="Glove" />
